description: Last of four Bell 47G bought by the IAF in 1954, 1962 war veteran; later Punjab Aircraft Maintenance Engineering College Patiala; gifted by Punjab Govt and unveiled on a pedestal at the CATS museum 17 Nov 2014 (warbirds.in; Bharat Rakshak BZ-544). Inside an Army school.
museum_name: Combat Army Aviation Training School Nashik
